conventions.offsets: Python str indices (Unicode code points) into the source file decoded as UTF-8; 's-e' half-open; several ranges joined by ';' are concatenated without separator
conventions.segmentation: a unit ends after one of 。；？！ plus any immediately following closing marks 」』”’）》〉 or further terminators; also at a paragraph/line end in line-based files; verse units (偈) end only at 。？！ or the closing 」
conventions.tsv_escaping: text fields escape \ as \\, tab as \t, newline as \n, CR as \r
conventions.unit_types: 经 传 偈 释 注 本文 说 序 题 (说 = 經說; 序 = preface; 题 = title/attribution lines)
